user.title: Core router
user.description: The router that runs DHCP, Wi-Fi and the uplinks. With “Generate a script” you get a ready block to paste into its terminal (HA address and a random password filled in); the rest — forward rule to the radios, internet probes — the integration sets up itself.

data_description.host: The router's address in Home Assistant's own segment — usually its gateway (prefilled). No need for an admin-network address.

onboard.title: Paste into the router terminal
onboard.description:
Open a terminal on **{host}** (Winbox → New Terminal or SSH) and paste the block below. It enables HTTPS (www-ssl) for Home Assistant **{ha_ip}** only, creates the user `ha-infra` with a random password and a firewall rule. Then press Submit.

```
{script}
```

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the RouterOS REST API. Was the block pasted completely? Check that www-ssl is enabled and HA's address is allowed.
error.not_routeros: The device answered but does not look like RouterOS

user.title: Add MikroTik device
user.description: The core router sees {count} MikroTik neighbours not added yet. Pick one or enter an address.

reconfigure.title: {host}
reconfigure.description: New address or login of this device. For the `ha-infra` user created by the onboarding block nothing changes when you change your own admin password.

onboard.title: {name}: paste into the terminal
onboard.description:
Open a terminal on **{host}** (from Winbox: Neighbors, or `/system ssh {host}` from the core router) and paste. Read-only user `ha-infra` with a random password; HTTPS for Home Assistant only.

```
{script}
```

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the RouterOS REST API. Was the block pasted completely? Check that www-ssl is enabled and HA's address is allowed.
error.not_routeros: The device answered but does not look like RouterOS

user.title: 4G router (Tandem-4GT)
user.description: The cellular router in front of the core router. Its web interface login (default root / root — change it).

reconfigure.title: {name}: address and login
reconfigure.description: Enter the new login after changing it on the 4G router.

error.cannot_connect: No answer from its web interface
error.not_tandem: Answered, but this is not a Tandem modem page

user.title: Add switch
user.description: The core router watches {count} switches not added yet. Pick one or enter an address.

credentials.title: Switch {host}
credentials.description: Password of the switch web page (PS308GV3 / PS208GV3). Home Assistant logs in only for a moment on each poll, so the web page stays usable.

reconfigure.title: {name}: address and password
reconfigure.description: Enter the new password after changing it on the switch.

error.switch_busy: Someone is logged into the switch web page right now — log out there and retry

user.title: Add VPN gateway
user.description: A provider's hub (MikroTik with a public address whose tunnel reaches this site). Admins of this site connect to it and reach only this site's networks: {nets}. Home Assistant gets no login on the hub: the hub fetches this site's public keys from HA once a minute.

data.name: Name shown in the panel
data.endpoint: Public address of the hub for clients (name or IP)
data.client_net: Client network of this site on the hub (one /24 per site)
data.hub_ip: Hub address as HA sees it (only it may fetch the list; empty = any)

script.title: {name}: paste into the hub's terminal
script.description:
Run this on the hub once. It creates the client WireGuard interface (if missing), firewall rules that let this site's clients reach only this site, and a script that syncs peers with Home Assistant every minute. Re-pasting is safe.

```
{script}
```

reconfigure.title: VPN gateway
reconfigure.description:
Public address and hub address. The hub script (paste again after changing the hub address):

```
{script}
```

data.endpoint: Public address of the hub for clients
data.hub_ip: Hub address as HA sees it

error.bad_network: Not a valid network (e.g. 10.250.5.0/24) or address

data.wg_stale_seconds: WireGuard handshake considered lost after, s
data.auto_configure: Configure the core router automatically (forward rule to radios, internet probes)

add_family_device.name: Add to family
add_family_device.description: Map a Wi-Fi MAC to the family VLAN on the core router (access-list) and make the client reconnect.

remove_family_device.name: Remove from family
remove_family_device.description: Delete the family access-list entry; the client falls back to the guest VLAN.

set_device_segment.name: Place Wi-Fi device
set_device_segment.description: Put a Wi-Fi client into the family or admin VLAN, or back to guests (access-list of the core router).

modem_select_sim.name: Switch modem SIM
modem_select_sim.description: Make the given SIM slot active. The uplink drops for 6-9 s.
